summary: Move the threshing example from Preterit to Infectum-wa
rationale: The illustrated form mdaqǝdqowalle is mdaqǝdqo-wa-lle, feminine singular Infectum with -wa and the plural object suffix. The surrounding mxalfǝnwanne, mǝḥyowayla and howǝnwa also describe habitual past activity. The exact matching supplied interview passage translates she would thresh them, confirming the past imperfective form. It is not a Preterit of mdaqdaqle.
